entities.name: Habib ibn Abi Ubayda al-Fihri

entities.summary: Habib ibn Abi Ubayda al-Fihri was an Arab military commander of the Fihrid family who played an important role in the early history of Ifriqiya (Tunisia), al-Andalus (Spain) and Sicily.
